[[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Hego Damask]], secretly the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] Darth Plagueis, owned a '''private retreat''' on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Sojourn (moon)|Sojourn]]. It was here that he would host annual gatherings where he would meet with various figures of corporations and other entities. In [[67 BBY/Legends|67 BBY]], Damask hosted a gathering where he would meet with [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Pax Teem]], [[Gardulla Besadii the Elder/Legends|Gardulla Besadii the Elder]] and others including the [[Gossam/Legends|Gossam]] representatives of [[Subtext Mining]].<ref name="DP" />

Across the years, Damask and his apprentice [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] would meet at this retreat, enacting the various stages of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Grand Plan/Legends|Grand Plan]], instituted by [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]] a [[1000 BBY/Legends|millennium ago]]. After Damask was injured on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during a [[Attack on the Lodge of the Canted Circle|minor skirmish]] with [[Maladian]] assassins in [[52 BBY/Legends|52 BBY]], Damask lived in seclusion in the retreat. The retreat was destroyed by a nuclear blast in [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]] on the orders of the [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] King [[Ars Veruna/Legends|Ars Veruna]], who wished to rid himself of Damask.<ref name="DP" />
